title: Openline installation tutorial — source-grounded editorial audit

sources.name: Openline staging installation guide
sources.findings: QR and manual alternatives; purchase code must first be redeemed; supplied eSIM details are distinct. Primary for calls/messages/iMessage; Openline for data; data switching off. Page contradicts itself on activation: confirm activation starts plan versus destination-only activation. Do not universalize either trigger, single-use QR, non-restorability, 24/7 support, instant setup, or bars proving internet.

sources.name: Apple eSIM setup
sources.findings: Compatible device, carrier support and network connection. QR and manual options. Manual via Cellular/Mobile Data, add plan, Enter Details Manually. Confirmation code only if supplied. Labels vary.

sources.name: Apple Dual SIM
sources.findings: Unlocked required for two carriers. Line labels editable under Cellular Plan Label. Defaults for calls and messages, iMessage and FaceTime. One cellular-data line at a time. Data switching changes behavior; disable for deliberate travel-data selection. Existing contact conversations may retain previously selected line. iOS26 travel journey is conditional.

sources.name: Apple international travel
sources.findings: No SIM Restrictions under Carrier Lock indicates unlocked. iOS26 may offer Home/Abroad and Travel eSIM Only versus Travel eSIM and Current eSIM. Both-lines use can still incur home roaming fees. Follow supplied plan rules; do not infer commercial validity timing from system prompts.

sources.name: Saily iOS guide
sources.findings: Settings > Mobile Service/Cellular > Add eSIM > Use QR Code > Enter Details Manually. Has Home/Abroad and Data Only branch. Saily app, address, activation, installation confirmation are Saily-specific and must not be attributed to Openline.

sources.name: Saily Android guide
sources.findings: Samsung-style Settings > Connections > SIM manager > Add eSIM > Scan QR code from service provider, Enter activation code. Alternate Network & internet > SIMs > Add SIM > Download a new eSIM; Need help? permits manual code. App capabilities and activation rules excluded.

sources.name: Holafly iPhone guide
sources.findings: Conservative QR scan via Settings. Manual SM-DP+ address and activation code. Separates iOS26 travel branch and classic labeling. Avoid all Holafly-specific commercial activation/reinstall claims. Do not tell users they must disable primary if they want conventional calls/SMS.

sources.name: Google Pixel eSIM setup
sources.findings: Official current Settings > Network & internet > SIMs > Add SIM > Set up an eSIM. Manufacturer and carrier availability conditions apply. Confirms narrated Pixel menu names.

sources.name: Samsung Galaxy SIM setup
sources.findings: Official Settings > Connections > SIM manager > Add eSIM > Scan QR code. Exact options depend on version and device. Confirms narrated Samsung menu names.

sources.name: Samsung manual entry
sources.findings: Manual option after Add eSIM > Scan QR code > Enter activation code. Supports depicting QR and manual as alternative routes on Android; no Samsung automatic commercial plan-start claim generalized to Openline.

sources.name: Runware Kling Avatar Pro documentation
sources.findings: klingai:avatar@2.0-pro supports up to five minutes, single image/audio; published $0.087/second. One continuous take, final native resolution verified from actual result, not promised as native1080p.

editorial_rules: Choose QR OR manual, not both; show both as alternatives, never imply consecutive installation.
Every setup code shown must be an obvious nonfunctional example. QR illustration is not an installation QR.
No blanket activation trigger: follow the instructions and validity conditions supplied with this plan.
iOS26 travel screens conditional; final settings reviewed independently rather than forcing classic wizard.
Home data roaming off does not eliminate possible calls/SMS charges.
Connection test is Wi-Fi off plus loaded webpage; bars alone insufficient.
Contact Openline support before deleting eSIM.
End URL and QR must be https://openline.com/install; parent resolving current404, no substitute.
